name: round_case
title: Round case for a product
summary: Snap shut case for a round product in the catalog (an AirTag, a tracker tag, a puck), built from the maker's published profile: two half shells hinged by a flexure at the back and closed by a latch at the front, open over every feature the maker locates on the top.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact product, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: material
params.help: PETG bends further before it yields, for the hinge and latch

params.name: clearance
params.help: room per side between the product and the case

params.name: lip
params.help: how far the rim reaches over the top edge when nothing on the top must stay open
